title: Fix generation rule source table validation
summary: Fixed source table validation for quality inspection generation rules to prevent clearing the source table through programmatic modifications while allowing legacy rules without a source table to remain editable.
key_points: OnModify now reads persisted generation rule data instead of relying on xRec
Prevents accidental clearing of source table on existing rules via programmatic changes
Legacy rules stored without source table remain editable
Temporary records keep previous validation behavior
